video.title: Video Intelligence Agent
video.description: Analyses YouTube highlights for engagement ratios, title sentiment, and tactical momentum signals, then blends them into the swarm prediction.

captions.highlightsArgentina: Highlights query result: “Argentina 2-0 Austria | FIFA WC 2026™”. The agent reads the title for positive keywords such as win and victory, then retrieves view and like counts.
captions.highlightsGermany: Highlights query result: “Ecuador 2-1 Germany | FIFA WC 2026™”. The upset result adds negative title signals for Germany and lowers its momentum score.
captions.tacticalArgentina: Tactical analysis query result: “Complete Argentina 2026 WC Breakdown”. A high engagement ratio between likes and views provides a strong momentum signal for the swarm.
captions.tacticalMessi: Tactical analysis query result: “Messi Breaks Records | Argentina vs Austria”. Positive title sentiment and high view counts increase Argentina's predicted win probability.
